Ting’anga Model Primary School Project TING'ANGA MODEL PRIMARY SCHOOL PROJECT Ting’angaModel Primary is a school located in Kiambu Town. It is one of the best performing schools in KCPE in Kiambu County. In a bid to improve the school learning experience and children lifestyle, Migaa performed a need analysis and came up with a work plan to address the needs identified. We started with the rehabilitation of the sports field and broke ground through a friendly football match between Migaa staff and students of TingangaModel Primary School. We also engaged in a tree planting session and refreshments thereafter. We continue to support the school in phase 2 which included the repairing of the classroom window.
